action: read-only pages used as UI equivalents of API list/get calls
method: UI in Claude in Chrome session, the test account, pt-BR, Free plan. Pages were opened and read; nothing was changed.

pages.seen: Contact attribute table. Ids seen include NOME, SOBRENOME, SMS, WHATSAPP, LANDLINE_NUMBER, COUNTRY, CONTACT_TIMEZONE, JOB_TITLE, LINKEDIN, DETECTED LANGUAGE, DOUBLE_OPT-IN, OPT_IN. The first and last name attributes carry Portuguese ids in this account.
Folders appear as the 'Pasta' column and in the move/list panels: 'Your First Folder' and the system folder 'marketing_automation' (see evidence/contacts.update_list.json).

Table 'Contatos <n>' with default columns CONTATO, INSCRITO, COLOCADO EM LISTA BLOQUEADA, E-MAIL, WHATSAPP, LANDLINE_NUMBER, ÚLTIMA ALTERAÇÃO, DATA DE CRIAÇÃO; search, filter and list/segment loading.

One default sender with state 'Verificado', tags 'IP compartilhado' and 'Padrão', links Editar, Endereço IP, Assinatura DKIM, DMARC, and the warning that a free-mail domain is not recommended. The address itself is not recorded.
Tab 'Domínios' with the empty state 'Configurar seu domínio' and the button 'Adicionar um domínio'.

pages.route: 'Uso e plano' popover in the top bar and 'Meu plano' in the account menu
pages.seen: Plan 'Free', daily e-mail allowance remaining, pre-paid e-mail credits 0, pre-paid SMS credits 0.
Rows with name, status (Rascunho), last edit, #id and columns Destinatários, Aberturas, Cliques, Inscrição cancelada, Conversões; filters by search and status; tags and folders are crown-gated.

limitations: Only the visible fields were read. Equality of these views with the API responses (field names, paging, filters) was not tested because the account has no API key.
